tool.name: listTasks
tool.description: List the tasks on the board, newest last. Pass a status to see only those tasks.
tool.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string","enum":["open","in-progress","done"],"description":"Optional status filter: open, in-progress or done"}},"additionalProperties":false}

tool.name: createTask
tool.description: Add a task to the board. It starts out open, and unassigned unless an assignee is given.
tool.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string","description":"What the task is"},"priority":{"type":"string","enum":["low","medium","high"],"description":"How much it matters: low, medium or high. Defaults to medium."},"assignee":{"type":"string","description":"Who the task belongs to. Left unassigned when omitted or blank."}},"required":["title"],"additionalProperties":false}

tool.name: setTaskStatus
tool.description: Move a task to a different status, for example to start or finish it.
tool.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"taskId":{"type":"string","description":"Id of the task, for example T-1003"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["open","in-progress","done"],"description":"The status to move it to: open, in-progress or done"}},"required":["taskId","status"],"additionalProperties":false}

tool.name: assignTask
tool.description: Give a task to someone, replacing whoever holds it now.
tool.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"taskId":{"type":"string","description":"Id of the task, for example T-1003"},"assignee":{"type":"string","description":"Who the task should belong to"}},"required":["taskId","assignee"],"additionalProperties":false}
